description: REQUIRES prior hometax__session__login call with same account_link_id. Search the list of trade partners the customer has registered for management. 호출마다 토큰 1소진

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

srt_cl_cd.description: Sort column (정렬 기준): '1'=name(거래처명), '2'=business number, '3'=representative, '4'=registration date. Default '1'.

txpr_dscm_no.description: Filter by trade partner business number (거래처 등록번호, hyphens ok). Optional.

txpr_nm.description: Filter by trade partner name (거래처명). Optional.

name: hometax__tax__trade_partner__search_list
